Exact integer multiplication gives Tr(A^2)=240, Tr(A^4)=1920, Tr(A^6)=18000 as claimed. Independent non-backtracking enumeration gives N3=0,N4=240,N5=0,N6=240 as claimed. Labels matrix is symmetric with label->sign mapping {0:[-1],1:[+1]} (120 edges each), consistent with generator-invariant epsilon*=(-1,+1); base is connected (BFS 60), triangle-free (0 triangles), non-bipartite. Lower bound: integer Rayleigh vector gives vTAv=3405552, vTv=998898, quotient 3.4093090586; for symmetric A, vTAv/vTv<=lambda_max<=rho, so rho>=3.409309059 exactly. Upper bound: re-ran inputs/artifacts/certify_upper.py to completion: Bareiss fraction-free elimination on scaled matrices 86I-/+25A (U=86/25=3.44) reports all 60 pivots positive for both U-A and U+A (CERTIFY_UPPER_OK), hence by Sylvester both 3.44I+/-A are positive definite and every eigenvalue lies in (-3.44,3.44), i.e. rho<3.44 rigorously. Enclosure [3.409309059,3.44] has width 0.0307<=0.05 and lies strictly below 2*sqrt(3)=3.464101615 (gap 0.0241), so verdict 'two-sided Ramanujan' follows deductively. Float spectrum (+-3.409321836) is consistent corroboration only, correctly distinguished from the two exact proofs.
